items.title: Researchers Identify Suspicious Activity on Kalshi and Polymarket Before Times/Siena Poll Release
items.description: A trader placed well-timed bets on Polymarket and Kalshi in two Senate races. It was unclear if the person had access to inside information or simply made good trades.

items.title: Prosecutors Charge Paraguay’s Former President With Corruption
items.description: Santiago Peña was impeached, removed from office, placed under house arrest and charged with using his office to enrich himself after a bank with close ties to his administration went under.

items.title: Trump Appeals Dismissal of $10 Billion Libel Suit Against Wall Street Journal
items.description: A judge has twice tossed the president’s defamation complaint, which centered on an article about a birthday greeting to the sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: They Spent Millions to Keep Their Dream Cruise Afloat. It Died Anyway.
items.description: Secrecy, debt and soaring fuel costs all contributed to the Odyssey’s downfall. Here’s an inside look at how the “endless cruise” unraveled.
